what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Bermuda in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 101 asylum seekers from Bermuda, and the United States hosted 100.0% of them.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Bermuda, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2005 at 5 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
